## Structural Notes

- **Web App Pattern**: Separate asset bundle (`pos_self_order.assets`) serves customer-facing OWL app independent of POS backend UI
- **Mobile-First**: Responsive design for tablets and smartphones; PWA manifest for app-like experience
- **Session Linking**: Self-order sessions linked to POS sessions via sequence ID (created post-init)
- **QR Code Integration**: pos_restaurant floor/table models extended to generate QR codes pointing to self-order entry
- **Real-Time Sync**: Orders placed in self-order app immediately visible in POS session
- **Extensible Customization**: Custom links configurable per table/session (pos_self_order_custom_link model)

## Notes for Higher-Level Synthesis

- **Extended Boundary**: Self-order is POS's customer-facing boundary; extends restaurant ordering experience to mobile/kiosk channel
- **Restaurant-Dependent**: Cannot function without pos_restaurant (floor and table models); auto-installs together
- **Multi-Session Architecture**: Separates customer-facing OWL app (pos_self_order.assets) from backend POS state (point_of_sale._assets_pos)
- **State Integration**: Orders created in self-order app are full pos.order records synced with POS backend; no separate order storage
- **Configuration-Heavy**: Feature flags and behavior controlled via res_config_settings (menu visibility, payment methods, custom links)
- **Sequence Dependency**: Self-order session IDs require pos_session sequence initialized at install (post-init hook)
